overall_goal: Prepare a saucepan with water on the hob.

goals.description: Set up the saucepan on the hob.
goals.rationale: The person handles the saucepan and its lid, placing the saucepan onto the hob.

goals.description: Measure water and pour it into the saucepan.
goals.rationale: The person uses a measuring jug to collect the correct amount of water from the tap and transfers it to the saucepan.
